task: RSCH-014 B7: BUG-087 enemy-rate design and fit preparation
classification_reason: Enemy-rate timer and fractional accumulator ownership, stage/death/spawn lifecycle, fixed enemy-module and page-34 boundaries, adaptive-clock interaction, and uncalibrated arcade-to-CoCo cadence.

scope.target_behavior: Default Easy/Medium arcade roaming-enemy progression, with existing border timer, player speed, pose timer, and adaptive policy preserved.

source_identity.patch_line_ending_check: With core.autocrlf=true, normalizing the checked-out patch from CRLF to LF reproduces the E2 receipt SHA-256 exactly.
source_identity.fixture_fidelity: BUG086 non-build hunks were applied from the supplied patch; the build.sh hunk failed apply-check and helper build/loader wiring was manually reconstructed. No post-BUG086/pre-B7 source hashes were retained. Treat this as a reconstructed fit fixture, not the exact E2 fixture or ROM. No combined-fit pass is claimed.

arcade_source_policy.basis: wiki/internal/tickets/evidence/rsch014-D/rate-policy-model.json and rate-policy-disassembly.txt; static model for the hashed local Lady Bug ROM.
arcade_source_policy.difficulty: Easy and Medium select table $0ED8; MAME default is Easy. Hard/Hardest and code $20 behavior are out of scope.
arcade_source_policy.movement_dispatcher: $407E after the $61E1 gate; it selects one shared integer step count and each active roaming enemy consumes that count.
arcade_source_policy.source_coordinate_unit: One visible arcade pixel per coordinate step, per Step D model.
arcade_source_policy.later_parts: The source offset reaches 15 and the Easy/Medium rate index saturates at 15. No later-part arcade motion capture or CoCo conversion is present.

timer_and_fraction_owners.$61B5: Shared 8-bit fractional movement accumulator, reset on stage initialization.
timer_and_fraction_owners.$61B6: Initialized to 96 logical-loop calls; reloaded to 60 on expiration.
timer_and_fraction_owners.$61B7: Elapsed byte incremented by the timer and saturated at $F0; its high nibble feeds rate selection.
timer_and_fraction_owners.first_part_1_easy_medium_rate_change: At $61B7=$60 after 5,796 source logical gameplay-loop calls, per Step D model. These are not verified MAME-frame or CoCo-tick units.

independent_owners.source_border_timer: $35E3 initializes and owns border-box timing; do not reuse CoCo BOX_TIMER.
independent_owners.coco_enemy_pose: ENEMY_TIMER/ENEMY_ANIM own enemy pose timing; do not reuse for movement rate.
independent_owners.adaptive_clock: BUG-058 approved two-tick/debt-discard policy controls admitted simulation ticks; it does not own enemy rate selection or fractional movement phase.

coco_evidence_and_gates.current_parent_transition: Parent-published controlled legal last-bonus/real-initialization quiet sample: all four enemies show 2 source-origin pixels per 2 logical ticks/2 raw Vbords in both parts. It is not arcade-rate acceptance and Part 2 is not separately pixel-verified.
coco_evidence_and_gates.route_and_later_part: B5 route did not reach Part 2. No later-part arcade enemy-rate capture exists.
coco_evidence_and_gates.cadence_conversion: Unknown. One enemy_tick per arcade dispatcher is only a model parameter; do not use it as an acceptance value. Calibrate movement dispatch cadence and elapsed-rate timer cadence against arcade captures.
coco_evidence_and_gates.fixed_quantum: CoCo et_find_movement emits 2-pixel quanta (horizontal +/-1 byte or vertical +/-320 bytes). Exact frame/phase compatibility with one-pixel arcade coordinate steps is unproved.

cycle_target.status: Still fails in the parent current evidence; B7 did not measure candidate cycle cost.
cycle_target.acceptance: No rate candidate is accepted by this result.

bounded_design.owner: One new shared roaming-enemy movement-rate owner, distinct from BOX_TIMER, ENEMY_TIMER/ENEMY_ANIM, player cadence, and adaptive elapsed/debt state.
bounded_design.parameterized_credit: For each admitted CoCo enemy simulation tick, add arcade mean coordinate pixels per dispatcher multiplied by a measured dispatcher-per-CoCo-tick conversion. Emit a 2-pixel movement quantum at each 2-pixel credit threshold. The conversion is unset until arcade_timing_research proves it.
bounded_design.progression: Initialize source-style countdown/bucket/fraction state only at a true stage initialization. Apply one common due quantum to each active roaming enemy so their movement phase follows the source's shared count. Spawned enemies join the current shared phase. Death/reset/release must not reset stage rate. Preserve $61B7 saturation at $F0.
bounded_design.blocked_or_frozen_motion: A due spatial event could be discarded while movement is blocked/frozen while elapsed rate phase continues, but no current evidence selects this policy; it is a behavior gate, not an approved rule.
bounded_design.hard_mode_and_nonroaming_actors: Excluded. No rate/pose ownership is inferred for player, vegetables, dormant den actors, death actors, attract, or instruction actors.
bounded_design.stage_wrap: The source arcade counter wraps 0xFF to 0; CoCo STAGE lifecycle mapping at rollover requires verification.

AD0_keyboard_E2_baseline.enemy_pre_lut_free: about 11 bytes per parent assignment; no B7 fit

allocation_and_fit.AD0_joystick: Known baseline overflow is 23 bytes; E2 candidate overflow is 34 bytes. Excluded from this scope; retain PERF-005 follow-up and do not claim it passes.

compact_enemy_assembly.result: fail at the required fixed boundary: zmb $17A0-* calculates -143 bytes.
compact_enemy_assembly.interpretation: This compact 8-bit fractional/parity candidate already exceeds the fixed enemy pre-LUT boundary by 143 bytes. It omits required $61B7 saturation, so this is an optimistic size result, not a complete or viable build.
compact_enemy_assembly.full_profile_guard: No complete combined source build passed.

initial_full_build_diagnostic.command: bash scripts/build.sh build (WSL, assigned worktree; profile environment not retained)
initial_full_build_diagnostic.failure: Initial 8.8 draft had unsupported 6809 opcode aba and zmb $17A0-* = -91. Partial resident/assets output is not a combined-fit result.

approved_BUG058_clock_candidate.source_transform: Four exact transformations retained in bug058-catchup-full-build.py: batch cap 4->2; barrier routes to rebase; clear AD_DEBT and AD_DEBT+1 on batch exhaustion; transition routes to rebase.
approved_BUG058_clock_candidate.fixed_vector_entry_checks: Five entries at $BD44/$BD47/$BD4A/$BD4D/$BD50 resolve to reset/batch/append/reducer/complete. Byte vectors at offsets $00/$03/$06/$0C remain unchanged; the reducer branch at offset $09 updates from 1600CF to 1600D5 because its target moves $BE1F->$BE25.
approved_BUG058_clock_candidate.combined_full_build: Not run. The B7 enemy module does not assemble at its fixed boundary; adding six bytes alone is only a projection, not a profile fit.

direct_page_conflict.committed_owners: $DF PRES_NAME_ROW; $E0 PRES_NAME_COL; $E1 PRES_NAME_REPEAT/PRES_TICK_PHASE; $E2 PRES_NAME_LAST_DIR/PRES_NAME_FLAGS; $E3 PRES_NAME_OWNER; $E4-$E5 PRES_NAME_PTR.
direct_page_conflict.decision: Do not treat $DF-$E4 as free RAM. Gameplay-versus-name-entry lifetime aliasing is possible only if explicitly proven; no such proof or allocation is included.

rejected_designs: Reuse BOX_TIMER: rejected because it owns border-box cadence and must retain matched behavior.
Reuse ENEMY_TIMER/ENEMY_ANIM: rejected because they own pose timing, not movement-rate progression.
Reuse adaptive AD_SIM/AD_DEBT or LAST_FRAME as the arcade rate owner: rejected because BUG-058 owns admitted tick/debt policy and CoCo-to-arcade timing conversion is unproved.

Per-enemy independent fractional accumulators: rejected because the arcade computes one shared step count for active roaming enemies; per-actor phases would introduce unsourced skew and spawn-phase behavior.

Put rate code in remaining page-$34 helper slack: rejected because only six bytes remain before reserved logo bytes; the approved banked clock helper independently uses 696/698 bytes and has two bytes free.
Add another bank/loader mapping: no physical ownership, delivery, or integration proof exists, and that protocol change is outside this step.

qa_and_disposition.design_verdict: No viable current source allocation. The compact measured candidate fails the fixed enemy boundary and its proposed six direct-page bytes overlap committed presentation state.
qa_and_disposition.BUG087_lifecycle: Keep Draft; not eligible for Ready or production execution.
eligibility_gates: Arcade_timing_research proves dispatcher cadence and elapsed-time conversion, including later-part movement captures and a Part 2 CoCo pixel-verified control.
Choose a physically owned, nonoverlapping code allocation or a smaller source-derived design that fits fixed LUT $17A0 across the required complete profiles without a new unapproved loader protocol.
Prove lifecycle safety for any direct-page alias and specify reset, spawn, blocked/frozen, death, and stage-wrap behavior.

Rebuild combined source with the approved 696/698 BUG058 helper and run complete keyboard/joystick capacity guards; preserve the 27,000-cycle target as a separate current failure until measured passing.
qa_and_disposition.residual_risk: No runtime/visible-output verification. No numeric timing acceptance is inferred. No combined fit or target pass is claimed.
qa_and_disposition.next_recommendation: Close the owned arcade timing/conversion gates and perform a new allocation design review only if a bounded source-level implementation can meet the fixed boundary. Do not expand into hardware or emulator-defect hypotheses.
